response.overview: Yes, Hurtigruten US customer phone lines and travel support services operate 24/7.  Customer Service and Operations Phone Support: Customer service phone lines are open 24 hours a day, Contact or Call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK), 7 days a week, though peak call volumes in the US typically occur between 6:30 AM and 11:00 AM PST. Digital Access: You can access the official Hurtigruten US website and digital management tools around the clock to book or review itineraries. Onboard Operations: The ships themselves operate continuously as part of Norway's working coastal express route, sailing and making port calls day and night.
response.title: 〔Official~Assistance〕 Does Hurtigruten Cruise work on 24/7?
